summary: Phases 1-6 and 14-15 of the fifteen-phase plan landed sorry-free and gate-green: a new SeparationZ/ subtree with the auxiliary until/since syntax over abstract leaves, the one seam to PlusFormula, GHR Lemmas 10.2.1 and 10.2.2 in full, and GHR 10.2.3's four single-sign cases with their separatedness discharged. Phase 5's decision gate measured 1 of 4 against a criterion of 4 of 4 — a Case 5 candidate is pinned and survives three probe models including the one refuting GHR's printed formula, but Cases 6-8 yielded none — so the plan's primary contingency closed Phases 7-13 with exclusions. The headline deliverable separationOver_ztime is NOT discharged and no tr row changed.
blockers: GHR Lemma 10.2.3 Cases 6, 7 and 8 have no candidate right-hand side. Their guard-failure condition is an exists-forall over the window below the evaluation point, and re-anchoring it at its rightmost witness retains a forward-looking bounded conjunct that cannot be an S-guard; the negation route between Cases 5 and 8 is circular. GHR 10.2.4 consumes all eight cases, so Theorem 10.2.9 and every deliverable resting on it are unreachable without them. Recorded in specs/867_formalize_gabbay_separation_ztime/prototype/cases-5-8-probe.lean's ## Gate measurement and in the plan's Phase 5 #### Reasoned Exclusions.
